title: Q1 Engineering Planning
summary: Reviewed Q1 objectives across all engineering teams. Infrastructure team to focus on reliability improvements, product team on new feature delivery. Budget approved for additional AWS resources.
decisions: Database optimization project approved with 6-week timeline
AWS budget increased by 40% for Q1
New checkout flow prioritized over mobile improvements
Weekly sync meetings to be scheduled for cross-team alignment
transcription: [09:00] Sarah Chen: Good morning everyone. Let's dive into Q1 planning. First item - infrastructure roadmap. [09:02] Mike Torres: We've identified three critical areas: database optimization, CDN migration, and monitoring improvements. The database work is blocking other initiatives. [09:08] Sarah Chen: Timeline for database optimization? [09:09] Mike Torres: Six weeks. We've already done the initial assessment. [09:11] Jen Park: From the product side, we're aligned. New checkout flow is priority one, but we need the database work done first. [09:15] Sarah Chen: Budget discussion. We need approval for additional AWS spend. [09:17] David Kim: Approved up to 40% increase. Just keep me posted on actuals vs forecast. [09:20] Sarah Chen: Great. Let's move to action items.
